integrity: The equivalence is proved symbolically from the distance formula, incidence counting, and König bipartite edge coloring. The bundled computation checks a \(31\)-point projective-plane instance only; it is not used as a proof of the universal theorem or of the published configuration spectrum.
limitations: The structural theorem classifies only the equality layer \(|C|=n\) and does not determine subextremal code sizes at lengths where no symmetric configuration exists. The numerical threshold uses the published spectrum of symmetric configurations with line size six.
title: Edge-colored symmetric configurations classify all-distinct extremal constant-composition codes
